scoreReanalysis.rationale: Second pass retained 58 as a real score, not a cap: Dunino has two independently worthwhile See entries, one community walking resource and modest visitor parking, but no café, public toilet or verified picnic provision, and the visit remains a compact attraction cluster rather than a rounded 60+ town experience.
